import sys, json, random, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import main as M

def bench(name, rules, npackets, W=32, plimit=10**9, seed=1):
    cfg={"version":1,"idle_timeout":10**9,"packet_limit":plimit,"prefix_width":W,"rules":rules,"fallback":{"class":0}}
    v=M.validate_config(cfg); prog=M.program_from_config(v)
    t0=time.time(); eng=M.Engine(prog); tb=time.time()-t0
    eng.handle({"op":"open","flow":0,"time":0}, False)
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    t=0; total_ev=0
    t0=time.time(); done=0
    while done<npackets:
        b=min(1024,npackets-done)
        pk=[]
        for i in range(b):
            t+=1
            pk.append({"flow":0,"time":t,"source":(done+i)%2,"length":rng.randint(1,2048)})
        ev=eng.handle({"op":"chunk","packets":pk}, False)
        total_ev+=len(ev["events"]); done+=b
    el=time.time()-t0
    print(f"{name}: build={tb:.2f}s stream={el:.2f}s events={total_ev} P={eng.matcher.P}")

rng=random.Random(2); rules=[]
for i in range(2048):
    rg=[]
    for _ in range(8):
        lo=rng.randint(-2048,2048); hi=rng.randint(lo,2048); rg.append([lo,hi])
    rules.append({"id":i,"class":0,"priority":0,"ranges":rg})
bench("2048x8-random 1e6",rules,1000000)

# many matches: 512 rules each length 8 all [1,2048] -> matches every packet after 8 for positive-source but sign flips
rules=[{"id":i,"class":0,"priority":0,"ranges":[[-2048,2048]]*8} for i in range(512)]
bench("512x8-allmatch 300k",rules,300000)
PYEOF
